items.text: Dear Chemists,
We’re thrilled to bring you a fresh update to enhance your journey in Potion Permit!
Here’s a rundown of what’s new, improved, and fixed in this patch:
Fixed missing activation trigger on some Side Events.
Adjusted excluded event list for player's progression.
Fixed Blue Sea Cucumber key item name
Fixed Leano FP2 & 3 activation time
Fixed HP bar UI visual when upgrading health

Fixed photo album page not syncing on closing and re-opening
Fixed cannot use mouse on the confession prompt

We hope these changes make your experience even more magical and engaging. Thank you for your ongoing support, feedback, and passion for Potion Permit.
As always, keep sharing your thoughts and discoveries!
Happy brewing!
PQube

Hey Chemists!

We come to you with exciting news! After implementing Japanese a couple of months ago, we have been brewing another update which is finally ready to be shared! We have added a new feature to the game! 🥳
While playing through a new tutorial, you'll be introduced to the Grow Box, a new object which will allow you to plant and grow your own material instead of having to forage it yourself.
Don't worry, our lovely townsfolk will give you the full rundown of how exactly this awesome new feature works and how to get your hands on the Grow Box and the seeds to make it work!
See below for the full list of features and fixes coming with the new update:
Version 1.14
NEW FEATURES
Added Grow Box feature
Added Ranger Post tutorial & event
FIXES
Fishing bar progress requirements adjustment
Furniture pricing adjustment
Fixed minor bug on world map
Fixed fish weight display
Fixed Godspeed Game's logo display within credits
Fixed Olive's schedule
We hope you have the best time trying out our new feature and we can't wait to hear what you think!
Happy growing, Chemists! 🌱
Happy Thursday, Chemists!
This week we're bringing to you a double patch with a bunch of fixes and an exciting addition to the game - we've added Japanese language to Potion Permit!
Thank you all so much for playing. We are excited to bring you many more patches and additional content in the future!
